rule: Unique case-sensitive .java paths per CVE; git diff --name-only --no-renames -z START FIX -- *.java; includes tests/resources; sum CVE-path counts across cases, not globally unique paths.
limitations: Path count is not security-label precision, source lines, processing time, build improvement or model accuracy.
Parent-diff equality retains the chosen patch paths by construction; independent check uses raw IRIS fix_info.csv annotations.
Some removed paths can be security context; context references are separate from the 409 changed-callable versions.
Missing seed objects are reported as exclusions; no network fetch is attempted.

[PLXUTILS-161] Commandline shell injection problems

Patch by Charles Duffy, applied unmodified

Merge pull request #87 from odinn1984/fix/fail_on_outside_target_files

fix: fail when trying to extract outside of dest dir

Fixed potential security vulnerability reported by Snyk Security Research Team

This is an arbitrary file write vulnerability, that can be achieved using a specially crafted zip archive, that holds path traversal filenames. So when the filename gets concatenated to the target extraction directory, the final path ends up outside of the target folder.
Add decompiled source for 1.3.3 (fixed) from zip4j-1.3.3-sources.jar

cases.fix_message:
[SECURITY-1534] Prevent remote execution by repo URL

SECURITY-1534 reports that user input in the repository URL field is not
validated sufficiently. A carefully crafted value in the URL field can
allow a user with Job administration permissions to execute an arbitrary
program on the Jenkins master.

Sanity check the values passed as repository URL to the ls-remote and
fetch commands so that user entered data cannot execute arbitrary programs
on the Jenkins master.

Use -Dorg.jenkinsci.plugins.gitclient.CliGitAPIImpl.checkRemoteURL=false
to disable URL checking.
